t: Free AI curricula, short lessons, and teacher resources for high school educators.
steps: Find the AI4ALL Open Learning site and look for the curricula.
Check that the page loads. Some AI4ALL pages returned errors during research.
Read the teaching guide for Explore AI.
Preview the Sentiment Analysis and Natural Language Processing curriculum.
Choose a Byte of AI as a short first lesson.
Check whether students need accounts for any tool.
Ask the vendor how long each curriculum runs.
